title: Civil Procedure Code (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No. 34 of 2000.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No. 34 of 2000.

body.heading: Amendment of section 544 of Chapter 101.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 544 of the Civil Procedure Code is amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:"
body.text: Section 544 of the Civil Procedure Code is amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:"

children.raw_text: (1) by the repeal of paragraph (a) of that subsection, and the substitution of the following paragraph therefor:" "(a) moneys in any account, other than a current account, in any licensed Commercial Bank or licensed Specialized Bank, within the meaning of the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988;"; and

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of any inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 3. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
